groups.name: Risa Hontiveros 2028 Presidential Campaign Movement Launch
groups.name_zh: 洪蒂维罗斯2028总统大选运动启动
groups.narrative: Supporters of opposition Senator Risa Hontiveros have launched the 'Risa Na 2028' movement to build early political momentum urging her to run for president in 2028.
groups.narrative_zh: 反对派参议员里萨·洪蒂维罗斯的支持者发起了“Risa Na 2028”运动，为其在2028年竞选总统进行早期造势。
groups.market_hint: Will Risa Hontiveros declare her official candidacy for the 2028 presidential election before the end of 2026?
groups.R_reason: An official public declaration of candidacy is a clear, binary event verified by media coverage and official statements.
groups.S_reason: Direct statements from the Senator or her official campaign team act as an authoritative resolver.
groups.T_reason: Explicit deadline of December 31, 2026.
groups.U_reason: While her supporters have launched the movement, declaring candidacy two years ahead of the election is highly debated; some advisors prefer waiting to sustain momentum, making the timing highly uncertain.
groups.H_reason: Risa Hontiveros is the de facto leader of the Philippine political opposition, drawing massive media and public interest.

contract_quality.R_reason: Clear binary outcome: she either makes a formal declaration or she does not.
contract_quality.S_reason: Resolved by primary source statements from the candidate herself.
contract_quality.U_reason: Balanced arguments for early vs. late campaign launches.

volume_potential.audience_reach_reason: National political figure widely recognized across all demographics in the Philippines.
volume_potential.stake_salience_reason: High ideological stakes for both opposition supporters (Kakampinks/liberals) and administration allies.
volume_potential.two_sided_conviction_reason: Supporters believe an early declaration is needed to build momentum against the Duterte/Marcos machineries, while pragmatists believe she will wait until 2027 to avoid becoming an early target of political attacks.
volume_potential.trade_now_trigger_reason: The launch of the 'Risa Na 2028' movement creates immediate speculative buzz.
volume_potential.update_cadence_reason: Interviews, Senate hearings, and political rallies will constantly provide hints on her timeline.
volume_potential.comprehension_speed_reason: Extremely simple question structure: will she declare by the end of 2026?
volume_potential.narrative_heat_reason: Deep political rivalries between the opposition, the Marcos administration, and the Duterte faction.
volume_potential.local_relevance_reason: Directly impacts the future leadership of the Philippines.

groups.name: BSP Jumbo Interest Rate Hike Policy Debate
groups.name_zh: 菲央行大号加息政策讨论
groups.narrative: While inflation showed signs of slowing down, persistent commodity and energy price pressures keep the option of a 50-basis-point jumbo rate hike alive by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas.
groups.narrative_zh: 尽管通胀增速有所放缓，但生活必需品和电力价格的持续压力使得菲律宾央行（BSP）加息50个基点的可能性依然存在。
groups.market_hint: Will the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) raise its policy rate by 50 basis points or more at its next monetary board meeting?
groups.R_reason: The exact rate adjustment is a precise numerical outcome stated explicitly in BSP policy statements.
groups.S_reason: Resolved by the official central bank of the Philippines.
groups.T_reason: Ends on December 31, 2026, covering all scheduled policy meetings in 2026.
groups.U_reason: While global pressures exist, domestic inflation dynamics and economic growth targets make a 'jumbo' 50bp hike highly debated among economists.
groups.H_reason: Interest rate hikes directly affect bank lending, mortgage rates, credit card rates, and stock market sentiment, making it a major news topic.

contract_quality.R_reason: Completely objective and numeric.
contract_quality.S_reason: Direct sovereign authority resolution.
contract_quality.T_reason: Aligned with the BSP's published calendar of monetary board meetings.
contract_quality.U_reason: Highly uncertain, depending on incoming monthly CPI data.

volume_potential.audience_reach_reason: Appeals to retail investors, business owners, professionals, and home/car loan borrowers.
volume_potential.stake_salience_reason: Interest rates directly dictate the cost of borrowing and returns on local fixed-income assets.
volume_potential.two_sided_conviction_reason: Hawks believe supply-side food and energy shocks will force BSP's hand, while doves argue that aggressive hikes would choke off fragile GDP growth.
volume_potential.trade_now_trigger_reason: Each monthly inflation print acts as a direct catalyst to place or adjust trades.
volume_potential.update_cadence_reason: Monthly CPI announcements, Fed rate decisions, and BSP governor speeches will shift odds regularly.
volume_potential.comprehension_speed_reason: Financially literate users easily understand a 50bp rate hike definition.
volume_potential.narrative_heat_reason: Debate centers around economic survival, inflation pain, and the cost of living.
volume_potential.local_relevance_reason: Directly concerns the Philippine economy and currency.

groups.H_reason: Geopolitical friction with China always garners significant headlines and public discussion.

groups.H_reason: GCash is the most dominant financial app in the Philippines, used by over 80 million Filipinos; security changes affect almost everyone.

groups.S_reason: The PSE is the sole operating stock exchange and public data collector for these transactions.

groups.U_reason: While the SEC streamlined rules to boost short-selling, local market culture is historically risk-averse, and liquidity has been historically low, making the adoption rate highly speculative.
groups.H_reason: Followed primarily by financial traders, stock brokers, and local market participants, but obscure to the general public.
